text.p: - Slovenia said on Sunday that abolishing economic sanctions on Yugoslavia should not release the frozen assets of former Yugoslavia's central bank.
- An opinion poll conducted for Delo showed that 62.7 percent of Slovenians were not satisfied with the work of parliament, while 44 percent thought the same about the government.
- In the first half of 1996, Slovenian construction firms finished building 202 apartments across Slovenia, a 71 percent rise in construction compared to the same period of 1995.

- Cargo ship "Brasil Star" on Sunday unloaded 177,866 tonnes of iron ore, a record quantity of iron ore unloaded in a Slovenian port. Transport to Austrian iron-works will take Slovenian trains more than two months.
- 43rd international fair of electronics is due to start on Monday in Ljubljana. The fair will host more than 570 exhibitors from 29 countries.

- Slovenian companies with more than 10 percent share of foreign capital are more than 66 percent more efficient than those without foreign capital, the Institute of Macroeconomic Analyses and Development said.
